Writer.title: AI writer

hero.title: Write an article with AI
hero.intro: Describe the story with the facts you have. The AI writes the article, prepares the Portuguese and English versions, suggests the section, tags and SEO, and creates a cover image. Then turn the proposal into a draft in one click.
hero.tipsTitle: What to include in the brief
tips: The facts: who, what, when, where and why.
Numbers, dates and names exactly as they must appear.
Quotes in quotation marks, with who said them.
Sources and links the newsroom has already checked.
samples: The city opened a 5 km linear park along the river today, with a cycle path and sports courts. The works cost R$ 12 million and took 18 months. The mayor said the park "gives the river back to the city".
Write a short note: the city library extends its opening hours from Monday, from 8 am to 10 pm, Saturdays included.
Write an explanatory article about the launch of a university satellite that will monitor wildfires, built by 40 students over three years.

remove.title: Delete conversation
remove.description: The conversation “{title}” and its proposals will be deleted. Drafts already created and generated images stay in the newsroom.

composer.label: Article brief
composer.placeholder: Describe the story: facts, numbers, quotes and sources. Or ask for changes to the last proposal…
composer.hint: Ctrl + Enter sends. The AI uses only what you provide; whatever is missing appears as [to confirm: …].

status.local: Local simulation mode: without an AI provider configured, the writer builds the draft from your brief, marks translations with [EN]/[PT] and draws an abstract illustration. No data leaves the server.
status.noImages: The current provider does not generate images: proposals will have no cover.

proposal.title: Article proposal
proposal.caption: Cover caption

proposal.applyLinkedHint: Replaces the linked article's title, subtitle, text, SEO, tags and cover (the revision history keeps the previous version).
